title: In Silico Prediction of ERRalpha Agonists Based on Combined Features and Stacking Ensemble Method.
authors: Xu, Jiahao; Huang, Zejun; Duan, Hao; Li, Weihua; Zhuang, Jingyan; Xiong, Le; Tang, Yun; Liu, Guixia
one_liner_zh: 该文用堆叠集成方法预测ERRalpha激动剂，属于小分子-蛋白靶标结合预测，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Estrogen-related receptor alpha (ERRalpha) is considered a very promising target for treating metabolic diseases such as type 2 diabetes. Development of a prediction model to quickly identify potential ERRalpha agonists can significantly reduce the time spent on virtual screening. In this study, 298 ERRalpha agonists and numerous nonagonists were collected from various sources to build a new dataset of ERRalpha agonists. Then a total of 90 models were built using a combination of different algorithms, molecular characterization methods, and data sampling techniques. The consensus model with optimal performance was also validated on the test set (AUC=0.876, BA=0.816) and external validation set (AUC=0.867, BA=0.777) based on five selected baseline models. Furthermore, the model's applicability domain and privileged substructures were examined, and the feature importance was analyzed using the SHAP method to help interpret the model. Based on the above, it's hoped that our publicly accessible data, models, codes, and analytical techniques will prove valuable in quick screening and rational designing more novel and potent ERRalpha agonists.
abstract_zh: 雌激素相关受体α（ERRalpha）被认为是治疗2型糖尿病等代谢疾病的一个非常有前景的靶点。开发一种预测模型以快速识别潜在的ERRalpha激动剂，可以显著减少虚拟筛选所花费的时间。在本研究中，从多种来源收集了298个ERRalpha激动剂及大量非激动剂，以构建一个新的ERRalpha激动剂数据集。随后，通过结合不同的算法、分子表征方法和数据采样技术，共构建了90个模型。基于五个选定的基线模型，性能最优的共识模型在测试集（AUC=0.876，BA=0.816）和外部验证集（AUC=0.867，BA=0.777）上得到了验证。此外，还检查了模型的适用域和特权子结构，并使用SHAP方法分析了特征重要性，以帮助解释模型。基于以上，希望我们公开可访问的数据、模型、代码和分析技术，在快速筛选和合理设计更多新型且高效的ERRalpha激动剂方面能证明其价值。
